title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378N (Provisions in respect of officers and other employees of inter-State co-operative society)

content.overview: Notwithstanding section 378O, all directors of the inter-State co-operative society continue in office for one year from the date of transformation. Every officer or other employee (other than a director of the Board, Chairman or Managing Director) becomes an officer or employee of the Producer Company on the same tenure, remuneration, terms, conditions, rights and privileges. An officer or employee who opts not to continue is deemed to have resigned. Transfer of services does not entitle compensation under the Industrial Disputes Act or any other law.
content.glance: Directors continue for one year; other officers and employees continue on the same terms; no compensation claim arises from the transfer.
content.study: Section 378N provides transitional continuity for directors, officers and employees on conversion of an inter-State co-operative society into a Producer Company. Directors continue for one year. Other officers and employees transfer on the same service conditions. Opting out is treated as resignation. No compensation is payable for the transfer itself.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Directors continue for one year from transformation; other officers and employees continue on the same terms; transfer does not attract compensation.

provisions.title: Provisions in respect of officers and other employees of inter-State co-operative society

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378N
examples.body: An employee of the inter-State co-operative society becomes an employee of the Producer Company on the same pay and leave entitlements from the date of transformation.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378N?
hypotheticals.analysis: It preserves continuity of directors (for one year) and of other officers and employees on the same terms, without compensation for the transfer.

rows.left: Continuity of directors, officers and employees
rows.right: Number of directors (s. 378O) or appointment of directors (s. 378P)

misconceptions.trap: Assuming the transfer itself creates a right to compensation under labour law.
misconceptions.correction: s. 378N(4) bars compensation claims arising solely from the transfer.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378N be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the person (director or other officer/employee). II. Apply the one-year continuation or same-terms transfer rule. III. Note the no-compensation bar.

examTips: Name s. 378N: Officers and employees on transformation.
revisionPoints: Directors continue 1 year; other officers/employees continue on same terms; no compensation for transfer
